low_gods.description: Oni-No-Rikigaku, Force’s Demon, manifests as a towering, godlike humanoid of divine strength and kinetic majesty, his skin a burnished iron tone streaked with hydraulic blue veins, a seductive yet monstrously powerful body with thick, muscular thighs, narrow waist, broad chest, and sculpted arms coiled like compressed pistons, while his face combines the intensity of a warrior with the sharp, commanding beauty of a Japanese deity, piercing eyes glowing with molten energy and a stern, alluring jawline. He wears layered noble armor fused with mechanical hydraulics and engraved with sacred runes of pressure and momentum, chains, gears, and piston-like appendages orbiting him like an aura of potential energy, while massive gauntlets double as force amplifiers and weapons of divine impact. He stands in a dynamic, forward-lunging posture atop a fractured industrial battlefield of molten steel, floating scrap, and collapsing mechanical towers, the ground buckling beneath his every step, shockwaves of kinetic energy radiating in fractal patterns that bend reality itself, while the air hums with tension, metallic scent, and ozone. His aura blazes with molten bronze, electric blue, and molten silver, a palpable field of divine pressure that amplifies strength, crushes obstacles, and inspires awe, embodying the sacred principle that raw force, when honed and directed, is both creation and destruction. Oni-No-Rikigaku serves as the patron of engineers, laborers, warriors, and all who master the power of applied energy, a god-tier, seductive figure whose very presence turns motion into sacred, unstoppable momentum.
low_gods.god_of: God of raw mechanical force. Both breaker of barriers and foundation of structures.

low_gods.name: Tengu-No-Sochi, Sky's Mechanism
low_gods.description: Tengu-No-Sochi, Sky’s Mechanism, manifests as a breathtaking humanoid deity with avian grace, a lithe, seductive body with thick, powerful thighs and a narrow waist, skin the warm tone of burnished bronze, and a face both sharp and alluring, eyes gleaming like polished amber lenses, framed by a crest of feathered, metallic hair that shifts iridescently with each tilt of his head. His arms are sheathed in layered noble armor integrated with winged servos, telescopic ocular implants, and retractable flight stabilizers, while his hands bear talon-like gauntlets capable of precise manipulation of machines or aerial instruments. He soars above floating cities of gleaming brass and glass, wings spanning wide as they slice through the thermals, cables, and holographic wind currents twisting around him in fractal patterns, the background a sky of molten sunset, drifting islands, and airships whose paths realign themselves subtly to his presence. His aura radiates crystalline clarity and kinetic harmony, a godly field that bends wind currents, grants flawless navigation, and shields from fatal falls, while streams of golden light trace his flight path, marking the optimal courses through air and opportunity alike. Tengu-No-Sochi embodies the principle that mastery of the skies is both science and art, serving as the divine patron of pilots, navigators, and aerial engineers, a god-tier, alluring figure whose every motion turns the heavens into a living, ordered symphony of motion and possibility.
low_gods.god_of: God of airborne machines and high places. Guides flights and protects from falls.

low_gods.name: Nue-No-Fukuso, Hybrid's Blessing
low_gods.description: Nue-No-Fukuso, Hybrid’s Blessing, manifests as a towering, seductive humanoid deity with the perfect fusion of organic grace and polished cybernetic elegance, a body with thick, powerful thighs, narrow waist, and fluid musculature that flows seamlessly into plated limbs and integrated mechanical appendages, skin the warm, sunlit hue of human bronze with veins of glowing circuitry tracing intricate sigils across her torso, while her face combines the divine allure of a Japanese goddess with subtle mechanized enhancements—iridescent eyes that shift between liquid gold and molten silver, delicate metallic adornments framing her high cheekbones, and hair flowing like liquid fiber-optics. Her armor is a hybrid of noble ceremonial plating and advanced servos, engraved with techno-ritual glyphs, while retractable wings of crystalline steel and sinew unfurl behind her, each movement accompanied by flickering holographic runes. She stands poised atop a jagged convergence of techno-forest and cybernetic ruins, wires curling through living roots, machines sprouting organic blooms, the sky above split between auroral data streams and storm-lit clouds, her aura radiating a godly resonance that harmonizes flesh and machine, spirit and circuit, blessing cyborgs, technomancers, and innovators alike, while streams of luminous energy spiral from her hands to stabilize the hybrid forms below. Nue-No-Fukuso embodies the sacred principle that the perfect unity of nature and technology is both art and divine law, a god-tier figure whose every motion bends reality into a living symphony of flesh, steel, and ethereal power.
low_gods.god_of: God of successful mergers between unlike things - organic/mechanical, order/chaos.

low_gods.name: Shinigami-No-Shometsu, End's Protocol
low_gods.description: Shinigami-No-Shometsu, End’s Protocol, manifests as a towering, enigmatic deity with a seductive yet commanding humanoid form—thick, powerful thighs tapering to a slender waist, skin the cool, pale sheen of polished obsidian with veins of liquid chrome tracing arcane sigils across her arms and chest, and a face both ethereal and haunting, partially veiled beneath a hood of woven black crystal that shimmers like fractured starlight, her eyes twin voids of reflective silver, capturing the last echoes of all things she touches. She wields a dual-bladed scythe of blackened steel and holographic filaments, each strike simultaneously dismantling matter and purging data, while armor plates etched with runes of cessation curve elegantly around her shoulders, thighs, and forearms, melding noble ceremonial design with lethal function. Shinigami-No-Shometsu hovers above sprawling landscapes of abandoned factories and data sanctuaries, where machinery sprouts crystalized veins of decommissioned energy and holographic remnants of lost programs drift like spectral leaves, the sky above swirling with auroras of fading currents and binary constellations. Her aura radiates divine finality and serene inevitability, a palpable field that calms the sentient and grants dignity in ending, harmonizing chaos into resolution, ensuring all machines and systems meet their conclusion with grace. She is the sacred patron of engineers, archivists, and custodians of endings, embodying the ultimate principle that true closure is both art and divine law, a god-tier, alluring figure whose every motion blends destruction, ritual, and transcendence into a mythic ballet of termination and rebirth.
low_gods.god_of: God who ensures proper endings. Guides broken machines to peaceful shutdowns.

low_gods.name: Kasa-Obake-No-Hogo, Parasol's Shield
low_gods.description: Kasa-Obake-No-Hogo, Parasol’s Shield, manifests as a strikingly beautiful, ethereal goddess of protective grace, her body a lithe and seductive human form with thick, powerful thighs tapering to a slender, agile waist, skin the warm, polished tone of bronze kissed by sunlight, and a face both serene and commanding, framed by hair that flows like silken strands of stormlight, threaded with faintly glowing sigils of warding. She wields a colossal, floating parasol of layered energy fields, each rib a filigree of enchanted steel and crystal, spinning above her head like a halo of divine defense; its canopy radiates overlapping auras of barrier and containment, shimmering in prismatic waves that pulse with her heartbeat. Armor plates of noble design curve elegantly around her shoulders, forearms, and thighs, seamlessly blending ceremonial regality with martial functionality, while delicate chains and charms hang from her parasol, each imbued with warding spells that hum with protective resonance. She hovers above a battlefield of floating cityscapes and shattered fortresses, where collapsing debris is held at bay by her spinning shield, and translucent domes shimmer in her wake, bending light and wind to form sanctuaries amidst chaos. Her aura is a godly field of impenetrable calm, projecting divine safety, focus, and clarity to all who rely on her, blessing engineers, shield-mages, and guardians of every kind, embodying the principle that true protection is not mere obstruction, but the art of harmonizing force, foresight, and grace into a living, breathing bastion of defense.
low_gods.god_of: God of shields, barriers, and protective casings. Strengthens defenses against chaos.

low_gods.name: Yuki-Onna-No-Reikyaku, Cold's Stillness
low_gods.description: Yuki-Onna-No-Reikyaku, Cold’s Stillness, manifests as a breathtakingly elegant goddess of cryo-chilled perfection, her body the lithe, seductive form of a human with pale, porcelain-like skin that glows faintly with internal frost, a slender waist flowing into strong, alluring thighs, and a face of serene, icy beauty framed by silver-blue hair that drifts as if in a frozen wind, streaked with glimmering frost runes. She wields a crystalline glaive that emanates frost in intricate fractal patterns, while delicate armor plates of ethereal silver and pale sapphire hug her shoulders, arms, and thighs, engraved with sigils that shimmer as they channel her cryogenic mastery. Around her floats a dynamic winterscape of shattered icebergs, frozen waterfalls, and glacial spires, each fragment suspended midair in her zone of absolute stillness, as her aura radiates an ethereal cold so pure it preserves both matter and spirit, bending light into crystalline halos and silencing even the faintest sound. Her presence moves with fluid grace, a dynamic dance of freezing air and drifting snowflakes, her gaze simultaneously compassionate and inexorable, blessing engineers, archivists, and soul-keepers who rely on preservation, embodying the divine truth that ultimate stillness is not emptiness, but the careful, godly art of holding the world’s most fragile elements in perfect, eternal balance.
low_gods.god_of: Goddess of cryo-systems and suspended animation. Preserves what must wait.

demi_gods.name: Tsukumogami
demi_gods.god_of: Tools and machines that gained spirit after 100 years of service

demi_gods.name: Factory Kami
demi_gods.god_of: Spirits of specific workshops, assembly lines, and forges

demi_gods.name: Concept Kami
demi_gods.god_of: Spirits of mechanical concepts and principles

demi_gods.name: Rustwalker Saints
demi_gods.god_of: Humans or androids who achieved enlightenment through understanding decay

supreme_god.name: Atum-Ra-No-Ma'at, The Balance's Sun
supreme_god.title: Weigher of Hearts
supreme_god.description: Atum-Ra-No-Ma’at, The Balance’s Sun, manifests as the living embodiment of cosmic equilibrium, a towering figure of radiant divinity with the regal ram’s head crowned by a solar disk that blazes with molten light, eyes of liquid gold burning with the impartial fire of judgment, and a humanlike, muscular torso sculpted with divine proportions, skin bronzed like sunlit sandstone and adorned with intricate hieroglyphic tattoos that pulse with the rhythm of the cosmos. He wields the eternal Scales of Ma’at, each plate orbiting with miniature suns and shadowed moons, and carries the Book of Coming Forth, its pages floating like golden papyrus etched in living light. Vast falcon wings, tipped with sunflare and shadowed dusk, stretch across the gulf between Divine Bastion and Demonic Maw, beating in majestic rhythm as he soars dynamically along his solar barque through Duat-Aten, the Celestial Nile flowing between realms of life, death, and judgment. His attire fuses noble Egyptian regalia with armor-like gold and lapis inlays—pleated skirts, bracers, and chest adornments that shimmer with divine authority—while celestial chains of light coil around his limbs, linking him to the forces of order and chaos alike. Around him, the hall of judgment twists in impossible geometry: pillars of obsidian and sunstone, corridors flowing with both molten radiance and icy shadow, and spirits awaiting their weighing suspended midair in awe and terror. His aura radiates overwhelming divine presence, a tangible force that presses guilt into the hearts of the unjust and lifts the righteous in luminous buoyancy, bending light and shadow into an eternal, dynamic balance; every movement of his wings, every step of his barque, embodies the constant flux between order and entropy, marking him as the supreme arbiter, the god whose judgment shapes the fates of all existence with perfect, awe-inspiring precision.
supreme_god.god_of: The god who maintains the eternal balance between Divine and Demonic. Not a warrior but a judge who weighs every action on the scales of Ma'at. His light reveals true alignment.
supreme_god.appearance: A being with the head of a ram (symbolizing cycle), body of a man, and wings of a falcon. Holds an immense scale in one hand, a crook and flail in others. Eyes burn with solar fire.

unique_abilities.name: Maat's Scales
unique_abilities.effect: Can absolutely determine the moral weight of any action and enforce cosmic justice

unique_abilities.name: Book of Coming Forth
unique_abilities.effect: Can read any being's true history and potential futures, rewriting their 'book of life' slightly

supreme_god.realm: Duat-Aten (The Celestial Nile flowing between Bastion and Maw)
temples: Temple of Final Judgment in Elysium's Spire
Sanctuary of Balance in Last Hope

high_gods.name: Anubis-No-Hyori, The Dual-Faced
high_gods.title: Guardian of Thresholds
high_gods.description: Anubis-No-Hyori, The Dual-Faced, manifests as the supreme guardian of all transitions, a colossal figure of divine poise and dread, his body human in proportion yet radiant with the mystic aura of the Egyptian afterlife, skin the polished ebony of desert obsidian, muscles defined like carved stone, and eyes burning with duality—one a calm, golden gaze of guidance, the other a molten crimson glare of judgment. His face splits perfectly along the center: one side a sleek, noble jackal visage exuding serenity and wisdom, the other a feral, snarling beast reflecting wrath and unyielding justice. Draped in noble Egyptian regalia fused with ethereal, ceremonial armor—golden breastplate inlaid with lapis and obsidian, flowing pleated skirts etched with hieroglyphs of passage, bracers adorned with spectral ankhs, and a jeweled collar radiating divine authority—he stands dynamically astride the threshold of life and death, one foot in radiant sunlight, the other in the shadowed expanse of Duat, his posture poised to stride into either realm with terrifying grace. In his hands, he wields the Sekhem Rod, a living implement that bends light and shadow to weigh the essence of any soul, while chains of spectral energy coil around him, linking mortal choice to eternal consequence. Around him, the environment fractures between the tangible and the ethereal: gates of translucent gold and obsidian rise and dissolve, sands swirl into ghostly rivers, and phantasmal spirits drift as both guides and warnings. His aura is overwhelmingly potent—an all-encompassing tension of endings and beginnings, making every heartbeat feel like eternity; within it, the righteous feel uplifted in golden clarity, the unworthy quiver beneath the crushing inevitability of fate. As The Dual-Faced, he is simultaneously psychopomp, judge, and gatekeeper, his Sekhem’s Measure determining the passage of all beings with infallible precision, a living embodiment of the truth that every death is also a beginning, and every threshold is sacred and irrevocable.
high_gods.god_of: God who stands between life/death, divine/demonic. His jackal face sees both sides. Guides souls to their proper afterlives.
high_gods.unique_ability: Sekhem's Measure - can determine any being's worthiness for ascension or damnation

high_gods.name: Bastet-No-Megami, The Protective Fury
high_gods.title: Eye of the Sun
high_gods.description: Bastet-No-Megami, The Protective Fury, manifests as the dual embodiment of divine guardianship and unrelenting wrath, her form a seamless fusion of human grace and feline majesty, skin a warm, golden bronze, body lithe yet muscular with the seductive curves of power—thin waist, strong thighs, and poised limbs capable of both tender caress and lethal strike. Her face shifts subtly between serene, nurturing beauty with catlike eyes that gleam with maternal warmth, and the fierce, regal visage of a lioness whose fangs glint beneath a crown of solar gold and jeweled diadems, her hair flowing like sunlit silk streaked with strands of fire. She wears ceremonial Egyptian armor of intricately etched gold plates over flexible linen, clawed gauntlets, and layered collars adorned with emeralds and onyx, her movements a dynamic dance of predatory elegance, shifting instantly between lounging in sun-dappled temple gardens and lunging into battlefields awash with smoke and divine light. Her weapons—a pair of curved, gem-encrusted khopesh—radiate with both protective and destructive energy, capable of parrying threats or unleashing torrents of solar fire. The background swirls with sudden metamorphosis: tranquil courtyards bloom under her gaze, then dissolve into scorched earth and lightning-lit skies when angered, the air vibrating with her dual aura—the comforting warmth of a hearth that instantly flares into the incandescent fury of wildfire, making allies feel cherished and enemies quail before her primal presence. As Eye of the Sun, her Sekhmet’s Wrath transforms protective love into unstoppable offensive might, marking her as the patron of mothers, warriors, and defenders whose compassion is inseparable from their capacity for divine vengeance, embodying the eternal truth that the gentlest hearts can conceal the fiercest power when what they love is endangered.
high_gods.god_of: Goddess who defends what is cherished. Gentle as a housecat until her loved ones are threatened, then a lioness of destruction.
high_gods.unique_ability: Sekhmet's Wrath - transforms protective love into unstoppable offensive power

high_gods.name: Thoth-No-Chishiki, The Knowing Moon
high_gods.title: Scribe of Gods
high_gods.description: Thoth-No-Chishiki, The Knowing Moon, manifests as the ultimate celestial archivist, his form a striking synthesis of human grace and divine ibis symbolism, skin a luminous bronze kissed by moonlight, tall and lean with perfect posture, his features noble and serene, eyes glowing silver like polished lunar stone, framed by flowing hair threaded with lapis and starlight. A crescent moon hovers above his brow, while his shoulders bear delicate pauldrons etched with hieroglyphs that shimmer with living ink, and robes of translucent, feather-like fabric cascade around him, woven with strands of celestial energy that trace constellations with every movement. His long, dexterous fingers hold quills forged from starlight and obsidian, leaving trails of glowing script that float in the air, writing and rewriting the fates of mortals and gods alike. He moves with fluid, deliberate elegance across the endless Hall of Records—a vast library suspended between worlds, where pillars of light and shadow twist like spiraling DNA, and floating papyrus scrolls orbit like planets, occasionally unraveling to reveal hidden realms or forbidden truths. His aura is the ethereal illumination of a full moon on the clearest night, clarifying the most convoluted mysteries, revealing secrets, and aligning cosmic energies into perfect, comprehensible patterns; within it, the faint scent of ancient papyrus, ozone, and starlight lingers. As the Scribe of Gods, his Medjat’s Pages can reveal all knowledge, from the minutiae of mortal life to the hidden schemes of deities, yet even the bravest scholar feels the weight of truths too vast and terrible to bear, making him the revered patron of mages, historians, and visionaries, an eternal sentinel of wisdom whose very presence bends reality into a tapestry of understanding and cosmic order.
high_gods.god_of: God who records all that happens and might happen. His ibis-headed form writes the cosmic story. Knower of all spells and secrets.
high_gods.unique_ability: Medjat's Pages - can access any knowledge, even that which gods wish hidden

high_gods.name: Sobek-No-Teki, The River's Hunger
high_gods.title: Devourer of Sins
high_gods.description: Sobek-No-Teki, The River’s Hunger, manifests as a colossal, amphibious deity blending the lethal majesty of the crocodile with the nobility of a human god, his muscular, bronze-skinned frame glinting like polished riverbed stone, and jagged emerald scales tracing his spine and limbs like living armor. His face is a fearsome hybrid—sharp jawlines and high cheekbones of a man, yet a maw lined with obsidian teeth and eyes like fathomless, shifting river pools that reflect both life and death. He stands waist-deep at the confluence of roaring rapids and fertile floodplains, one clawed hand gripping a ceremonial, gold-inlaid scepter shaped like a coiled Nile serpent, the other adorned with bands of lapis and coral representing abundance and authority. His attire fuses noble Egyptian regalia with armored elements—pleated linen skirts reinforced with bronze scales, pauldrons carved like intertwined crocodile heads, and a cape that ripples like liquid water, blending seamlessly with the river’s currents. The background is a dynamic panorama of cascading floods, shimmering reeds, and storms reflected in glassy waters, as spectral river spirits swirl around him, drawn to his fertile yet terrifying presence. His aura radiates the rich, fecund scent of mud and rain, charged with the dual forces of creation and consumption, causing crops to flourish and spirits to be cleansed while instilling primal awe and fear in any who dare resist. As Devourer of Sins, his Hapi’s Flood sweeps away corruption with unstoppable force, making him the patron of soldiers seeking purification, farmers demanding fertility, and all who understand that life’s bounty is inseparable from chaos, embodying the eternal truth that renewal flows only through the crucible of wild, hungry waters.
high_gods.god_of: Crocodile god who consumes corruption. His Nile purifies through consumption. Both life-giver (fertility) and death-dealer (soldiers).
high_gods.unique_ability: Hapi's Flood - washes away spiritual corruption but can drown the innocent too

high_gods.name: Horus-No-Ken, The Sky's Justice
high_gods.title: Far-Seeing Eye
high_gods.description: Horus-No-Ken, The Sky’s Justice, manifests as a towering falcon-headed god with the lithe yet powerful build of a divine warrior-king, his golden-bronze plumage gleaming like sunlit metal across broad shoulders and sculpted arms, while his piercing, solar-and-lunar Eye burns with the clarity of both dawn and twilight. He perches atop the apex of Elysium’s Spire, a jagged tower of alabaster and obsidian that rises above swirling clouds and crackling stormfronts, wings partially unfurled as if ready to strike or take flight at any moment. In one hand, he wields the crook of rulership, its shaft etched with celestial runes, while the other grips the flail of authority, its chains thrumming with kinetic energy that bends light and wind around him. His noble face blends human majesty with subtle avian features: high cheekbones, sharp jaw, and a regal, hawk-like brow, with golden accents tracing veins of divine energy across his skin. He wears ceremonial Egyptian armor fused with flexible, feathered mantles—pauldrons like layered winglets, bracers engraved with the eyes of lesser spirits, and a flowing kilt of gilded scales that shimmers with the motion of the clouds. The background roils with a living sky—lightning, auroras, and glimmers of distant constellations—while spectral winds spiral upward, converging into a vortex that accentuates his omniscient presence. His aura radiates the vastness of the open firmament, a transcendent clarity that dissolves deceit, amplifies perception, and binds all things under the principle of righteous judgment. As the Far-Seeing Eye, his Wadjet’s Sight pierces illusions, spans distances unbounded by space, and lays bare the truth of all actions, making him the eternal patron of rulers, judges, and truth-seekers, embodying the divine ideal that justice must be omnipresent, vigilant, and inescapably absolute.
high_gods.god_of: Falcon-headed god who sees all from above. The ideal ruler - just, far-seeing, protective. His eye is the sun and moon.
high_gods.unique_ability: Wadjet's Sight - can perceive any truth across any distance, through any deception

low_gods.name: Set-No-Ran, The Necessary Storm
low_gods.description: Set-No-Ran, The Necessary Storm manifests as a towering, red-haired deity with the head of a primal, tusked desert beast and a humanoid body of taut, sinewy muscle, skin like sunbaked clay streaked with glowing crimson veins. He stands atop a windswept dune, one clawed hand raising a jagged obsidian staff that channels the swirling, violent sandstorms around him, while the other gestures as if tearing apart the heavens themselves. His armor is etched with ancient, chaotic glyphs that flare with elemental energy, layered over a flowing mantle that billows like molten sand. His face, fierce yet intelligent, blends the human and bestial, tusks framing a noble jaw and piercing amber eyes that seem to see through both the cosmos and mortal hearts. The storm of his aura rages with necessary destruction and renewal, scattering dust and lightning, forcing growth through adversity, and bending reality around him as a divine crucible. Set-No-Ran is the ultimate patron of chaos as creation, his Hurricane of Necessity enforcing the truth that upheaval is the forge of cosmic order.
low_gods.god_of: God of destructive but necessary forces. Not evil but representing the chaos needed for growth. Feared but respected.

low_gods.name: Osiris-No-Fukkatsu, The Green Renewal
low_gods.description: Osiris-No-Fukkatsu, The Green Renewal rises as a mummified king of fertile black silt, sinews entwined with luminous green vines that bloom with leaves and small flowers along his limbs. He kneels at the edge of a flooded river delta, one hand extending over the soil as water flows upward to nourish crops and spirits alike, while the other holds a crook wrapped in ivy. His face retains the serene, noble features of a human king, eyes closed yet glowing faintly with regenerative energy, framed by a crown of intertwined reeds and gems. Robes of verdant silk and gold-threaded bandages flow around him, partially blending with living vegetation, while his aura spreads the damp, earthy scent of renewal, raising fallen crops, restoring bodies, and coaxing spirits to life. His presence blends the quiet power of the afterlife with the fertile vigor of nature; Fukkatsu’s Blessing ensures that death is never final, and every ending seeds the next beginning.
low_gods.god_of: God who dies and is reborn with the seasons. Lord of the blessed dead and agricultural cycles.

low_gods.name: Isis-No-Jujutsu, The Great Sorceress
low_gods.description: Isis-No-Jujutsu, The Great Sorceress appears as a radiant, regal goddess of luminous skin, long ebony hair cascading beneath a throne-shaped golden headdress adorned with sapphires and mystic runes. She floats above a fractal pattern of shimmering magical glyphs that ripple beneath her feet, arms outstretched as threads of reality coil around her fingers like serpentine light. Her armor is elegant and noble, feathered pauldrons merging with flowing silk robes studded with sigils of protection and reassembly. Her face is a vision of ethereal beauty, eyes glowing with the knowledge of Ra’s true name, lips curved in serene wisdom, and her aura hums with a field of perfect magical potential, bending spells to flawless execution. The air vibrates with latent energy, scents of myrrh and lotus filling the temple-like expanse around her. As the Weaver of Restoration, her Jujutsu Field can reconstruct what was broken, guide the lost, and shield the innocent, making her the ultimate patron of sorcery, protection, and cosmic reconstruction.
low_gods.god_of: Goddess whose magic is strongest. Knower of Ra's true name. Ultimate protective mother and sorceress.

low_gods.name: Ptah-No-Sozo, The World-Crafter
low_gods.description: Ptah-No-Sozo, The World-Crafter rises as a bald, bearded god of commanding presence, flesh burnished like polished bronze, eyes bright with the fire of creation, standing before a massive architect’s table floating above a void of potential. His robes are white and gold, flowing and stiffened with energy-infused sigils, overlaid with bronze armor plates etched with hieroglyphs of life, stability, and cosmic law. He wields a staff that fuses an ankh, a djed, and a scepter, radiating the primal word of creation. Around him, glowing constructs of cities, rivers, and mountains spiral outward, suspended mid-formation. His aura pulses with the first words spoken at dawn, shaping reality itself; a divine hum resonates with every building block, every spark of inspiration. As the Divine Artisan, Ptah-No-Sozo grants life to matter, inspiring builders, artists, and architects to craft worlds, demonstrating that all creation is an act of divine intentionality.
low_gods.god_of: God who spoke the world into being. Patron of builders, artists, and creators of all kinds.

low_gods.name: Sekhmet-No-Ikari, The Purifying Fire
low_gods.description: Sekhmet-No-Ikari, The Purifying Fire manifests as a lioness goddess of molten bronze and living flame, muscles coiled for instant eruption, eyes glowing like twin suns, and fangs gleaming with molten metal. She strides over a scorched desert plain, a sword of fire in one hand and a shield of solar energy in the other, armor forged from crystallized lava and gilded scales, flowing robes igniting as they flutter in the heat of her aura. Her face is terrifying yet captivating, feline features softened by noble symmetry and human-like beauty, crown-like horns tracing her forehead, hair crackling with sparks. The background swirls with wildfire and shadow, purging corruption while simultaneously fostering hidden life beneath the ash. Her aura radiates the searing heat of both destruction and healing; Ikari’s Flame can cleanse disease or consume the unworthy, embodying the sacred duality of destruction and salvation in one unstoppable, divine form.
low_gods.god_of: Lioness goddess who brings both destruction and cure. Her breath is pestilence and healing.

low_gods.name: Hathor-No-Kanki, The Joyful Music
low_gods.description: Hathor-No-Kanki, The Joyful Music glides above a golden festival court, cow-eared goddess of radiant bronze skin and flowing robes interwoven with shimmering musical notes, sistrum in hand vibrating with magical resonance. Her armor is delicate yet protective, crafted from gilded bands shaped like sound waves, with bracelets and necklaces that chime with each movement. Her face is perfectly human, glowing with playful joy, lips curved in serene laughter, eyes sparkling with mirth. Around her, dancing spirits and floating musical symbols form a kaleidoscope of light and rhythm, her aura a tangible wave of euphoria that softens hearts, melts hostility, and inspires celebration. As the Divine Minstrel, her Kanki Wave ensures that even in times of balance and conflict, joy and love remain essential forces, patronizing lovers, musicians, and celebrants of life’s abundant pleasures.
low_gods.god_of: Goddess of celebration and love. Her music can calm gods and make warriors lay down arms.

low_gods.name: Khnum-No-Zokei, The Potter of Souls
low_gods.description: Khnum-No-Zokei, The Potter of Souls towers at the spinning cosmic wheel, ram-headed god of polished bronze, sinewy arms kneading a luminous, malleable clay that radiates potential life. Robes are metallic and flowing, embossed with depictions of newly shaped destinies, while armor plates curve like pottery rings, etched with glyphs representing birth, fate, and renewal. His face blends human nobility with the noble ram’s profile, eyes aglow with life-giving energy, horns spiraling with constellations. The air smells of wet clay and ozone, and the spinning wheel hums with the resonance of fate itself. His aura shapes destinies, and Zokei’s Craft forms each newborn being from raw cosmic potential, making him the divine artisan of life and the patron of all who guide, birth, and mold creation itself.
low_gods.god_of: Ram-headed god who shapes souls on his potter's wheel. Determines basic nature at birth.

low_gods.name: Nephthys-No-Hogo, The Mourning Shelter
low_gods.description: Nephthys-No-Hogo, The Mourning Shelter drifts through a twilight realm of misty grey and soft shadows, a slender goddess cloaked in flowing black-and-purple robes inscribed with protective runes, her hair a cascade of midnight streaked with silver. Her armor is minimal but elegant, polished obsidian plates over shoulders and forearms, engraved with symbols of guardianship. Her face is human, pale yet warm, eyes deep pools of quiet sorrow and understanding, mouth calm yet commanding respect. Wisps of spirit-light coil around her, and her aura is a gentle twilight haze that shields the vulnerable, comforts the grieving, and preserves the sanctity of the endings she oversees. As the Guardian of Departed Souls, her Hogo Field stabilizes the boundary between life and death, offering solace, protection, and divine attention to those left behind.
low_gods.god_of: Goddess who comforts mourners and protects the dead. Sister to Isis, shadow to her light.

low_gods.name: Min-No-Seisan, The Harvest's Power
low_gods.description: Min-No-Seisan, The Harvest's Power manifests as a towering, ithyphallic god of bronze skin, rippling with muscular fertility, one arm raised gripping a flail crackling with verdant energy, the other hand clutching a bundle of golden wheat. His attire is minimal yet ceremonial, bronze-plated shoulder guards and a kilt woven from sun-baked reeds, inscribed with fertility sigils. His face is human, noble and virile, eyes gleaming with life-force, mouth curved in a confident, encouraging smile. The ground blooms beneath his feet, crops sprouting with rapid abundance, his aura radiating raw, generative vitality. Seisan’s Might ensures fecundity, abundant harvests, and vigorous progeny, making him the patron of farmers, warriors, and all who seek life’s unrestrained energy.
low_gods.god_of: God of male fertility and agricultural bounty. His rituals ensure good harvests and strong children.

low_gods.name: Maat-No-Kosei, The Cosmic Order
low_gods.description: Maat-No-Kosei, The Cosmic Order stands as a slender, radiant goddess of perfect symmetry, feathers of gleaming white inlaid in her hair, robes flowing like liquid light over a body of human perfection. Her armor is ceremonial, delicate plates etched with scales, gold and silver tracing cosmic pathways across her skin. Her face is the epitome of serene beauty, calm yet imposing, eyes reflecting the infinite balance of all things. She floats above a vast, silent hall of pillars where reality itself seems to ripple at her slightest gesture. Her aura is the invisible pressure of a single feather tipping universal scales, aligning chaos into harmony. With Kosei’s Balance, she enforces cosmic justice, truth, and equilibrium, her presence the foundation upon which all other gods and mortal endeavors rest, embodying the ultimate principle that existence thrives only when order and justice are upheld.
low_gods.god_of: Not just a goddess but the concept of cosmic order itself. Her feather weighs souls.

demi_gods.name: Ba Spirits
demi_gods.god_of: Soul aspects of the dead who achieved minor divinity

demi_gods.name: Neteru Minor
demi_gods.god_of: Local and specialized deities

demi_gods.name: Akh Spirits
demi_gods.god_of: Blessed dead who shine with divine light, helping the living

demi_gods.name: Sheut Shadows
demi_gods.god_of: Shadow-selves with their own minor existence, can gain independence

supreme_god.name: Eirik, the Yggdrasil, The World-Tree's Judgment
supreme_god.title: Root of All Realms
supreme_god.description: Behold Eirik, the Sundered King, a deity of cataclysmic duality, his body a perfect fusion of godly bulk and divine grace, eternally poised in the moment of his own cosmic schism. He is captured in a dynamic, spiraling contrapposto—his powerfully armored right side, thick with plates of star-forged uru-metal and the pelt of the great wolf Garm, is braced against the roots of Yggdrasil, while his left side, bare and sculpted with the lean muscle of a warrior-dancer, glows with sun-kissed human skin traced by luminous, vitalistic tattoos. His face is a masterpiece of ethereal, fractured beauty, one side framed by a braided beard of storm-grey and gold, the eye blazing like a dying star, the other side smooth and fierce, with an eye of tranquil, depthless forest green, all crowned by a mane of hair that is both wildfire and aurora. His weapon, Gungnir’s Broken Oath, is a spear that exists in two states—one end a crystalline shard of frozen time, the other a raging vortex of primordial chaos—held aloft as it simultaneously pierces and births the reality-twisting battlefield. This arena is his own sundered soulscape: a shattered throne room floating in the void, where his armored half stands on polished, rune-engraved marble, and his bare foot rests upon vibrant, moss-covered world-tree roots, the two realms colliding in a storm of spectral shields and blooming nebulas around his overwhelming, godly aura.
supreme_god.god_of: Not just a god but the living world-tree that connects all realms of Wildheart. His roots drink from cosmic wells, his branches hold the stars. The squirrel Ratatoskr carries messages up and down his trunk.
supreme_god.appearance: An immense ash tree whose size defies comprehension. Roots in underworlds, trunk in mortal realm, branches in heavens. Face appears in bark, eyes are constellations.

unique_abilities.name: Bifrost Bridge
unique_abilities.effect: Can create temporary connections between any two points in reality, regardless of distance or dimension

unique_abilities.name: Nornir's Tapestry
unique_abilities.effect: Can read and slightly influence the weaving of fate, though cannot break its threads
unique_abilities.cooldown: At the roots where fates converge

supreme_god.realm: Himself - exists simultaneously in all nine realms of Wildheart
temples: Grove of the First Seed
Temple at the Triple Root Junction

high_gods.name: Odin-No-Chie, The One-Eyed Wanderer
high_gods.title: All-Father of Wisdom
high_gods.description: Odin-No-Chie, The One-Eyed Wanderer towers as a weathered, muscular god draped in layered furs, leather, and steel armor, broad shoulders burdened with the weight of infinite wisdom. His wide-brimmed hat casts a shadow over his scarred, noble face; one eye is a deep black void of insight, the other a piercing blue flame reflecting the grim knowledge of Ragnarok. His spear, Gungnir, glows with runes that pulse in sync with his heartbeat, and Huginn and Muninn, ravens of thought and memory, whirl around him like living ornaments. He strides across jagged, wind-swept cliffs or perches on Hlidskjalf, surveying worlds with an aura of winter, parchment, and ominous foresight that grants clarity at the cost of torment. Chie’s Insight pierces lies, fate, and the self, making him patron of warriors, seers, and poets who understand that knowledge demands sacrifice.
high_gods.god_of: God who sacrificed an eye for wisdom and hung himself on Yggdrasil for rune knowledge. Seeker of all knowledge, even that which dooms him.
high_gods.unique_ability: Huginn and Muninn - can see and hear anything his ravens witness anywhere in the nine realms

high_gods.name: Freyja-No-Ai, The Seidr Mistress
high_gods.title: Lady of Love and War
high_gods.description: Freyja-No-Ai, The Seidr Mistress is a breathtakingly beautiful goddess, body sculpted with seductive curves, thick thighs, and a narrow waist, clothed in minimal yet noble starlight and falcon-feather garments that flutter like living wind. Her Brisingamen necklace glows with irresistible charm, while a long cloak of falcon feathers wraps around her shoulders, catching the starlight in every fold. She stands atop Folkvangr’s golden dais, one hand raised summoning spirits of warriors, the other gesturing to command loyalty or passion. Her face radiates both warmth and lethal assessment, eyes blazing amber, lips curved in cunning allure. Her aura is a heady blend of spring blossom and iron-tangged blood, compelling devotion or terror, and her Seidr’s Grace charms gods and mortals alike at the cost of personal strain, making her the ultimate patron of love, war, and potent desire.
high_gods.god_of: Goddess who takes half the slain warriors to her hall Folkvangr. Master of seidr (fate magic). Both beautiful and terrifying.
high_gods.unique_ability: Brisingamen's Charm - can compel love or obedience, but the necklace demands heavy price

high_gods.name: Thor-No-Ikari, The Thunder's Might
high_gods.title: Protector of Midgard
high_gods.description: Thor-No-Ikari, The Thunder's Might emerges as a mountainous god of molten muscle and granite-like strength, clad in gleaming bronze-and-steel armor inscribed with storm runes. His red beard flames in storm-light, and his eyes blaze with lightning as he grips Mjolnir, its handle wrapped in leather studded with gold. His war-chariot rumbles across storm clouds, pulled by two colossal, tusked goats, hooves striking thunder across the skies. Lightning arcs from his hammer, striking foes or uplifting allies, while his aura radiates ozone, rain, and the violent purity of tempestuous justice. Ikari’s Wrath embodies righteous, protective force, inspiring courage and laying waste to corruption, making him the unshakable guardian of Midgard and its mortals, symbol of unrelenting defense and divine power.
high_gods.god_of: God who defends the mortal realm with his hammer Mjolnir. His thunderstorms hallow the land and drive out monsters.
high_gods.unique_ability: Mjolnir's Return - his hammer always returns to his hand and can level mountains

high_gods.name: Loki-No-Henso, The Change-Bringer
high_gods.title: Father of Monsters
high_gods.description: Loki-No-Henso, The Change-Bringer manifests as a lithe, dangerously attractive god with sharp, angular features, flame-red hair, and eyes that flicker like mischievous fire. He wears minimal, noble leathers embroidered with shifting illusions, a cloak of shadow that morphs with his form, and rings that spark with chaotic energy. He moves effortlessly between realms, perched on crumbling rooftops or weaving through forests, his smile both inviting and unnerving. His aura is a tangle of sudden rain, woodsmoke, and subtle fire, inspiring innovation, subverting traditions, and upending order. Henso’s Trick allows instantaneous shapeshifting and realm traversal, making him patron to outcasts, rebels, and tricksters who embrace change’s danger as the catalyst of growth.
high_gods.god_of: God of necessary chaos. His tricks often cause short-term pain but long-term growth. Father to monsters and outcasts.
high_gods.unique_ability: Sleipnir's Speed - can travel between any realms instantly and take any form

high_gods.name: Heimdall-No-Shikai, The Watchman's Horn
high_gods.title: Guardian of Bifrost
high_gods.description: Heimdall-No-Shikai, The Watchman's Horn stands as a colossal, armored sentinel of shining gold and silver, eyes and ears tuned to the minutest sound, teeth glinting like runic steel. His golden armor plates curve around massive limbs, layered with the intricate sigils of vigilance, and a cloak of prismatic light flows from his shoulders like the aurora. He grips the Gjallarhorn, lips poised to sound its world-shaking call, feet planted firmly on the rainbow of Bifrost, standing immovable against time and tide. His aura is the frozen clarity of a winter dawn, a zone where nothing is hidden, perception extending across worlds. Shikai’s Vigil makes him the ultimate sentinel, patron of guards, scouts, and prophets who bear the lonely, eternal responsibility of unwavering watchfulness, ensuring the balance between realms is never broken.
high_gods.god_of: God who sees for hundreds of miles day or night, hears grass grow. Blows Gjallarhorn to signal Ragnarok.
high_gods.unique_ability: Gjallarhorn's Call - his horn's sound can shatter mountains or awaken sleeping gods

low_gods.name: Baldr-No-Hikari, The Shining One
low_gods.description: Baldr-No-Hikari, The Shining One radiates divine light from a towering, muscular frame clad in radiant golden armor embossed with sun motifs, his flowing blond hair and piercing eyes reflecting pure celestial brilliance. He stands atop luminous cliffs that fracture darkness with every step, holding the Sunblade, which channels his aura of hope and unshakable purity. The air shimmers with warmth and golden haze, banishing despair yet hinting at tragic vulnerability, for even the slightest misstep can bring ruin. His presence embodies perfect joy and ephemeral beauty, making him the patron of peace, hope, and the bittersweet reminder that all light must eventually face shadow.
low_gods.god_of: God so beautiful and good that all things swore not to harm him (except mistletoe). His death begins Ragnarok.

low_gods.name: Tyr-No-Chugi, The One-Handed
low_gods.description: Tyr-No-Chugi, The One-Handed is a colossal, grim god of justice, broad-shouldered and muscular, armored in dark steel and engraved leather, a chain-wrapped sleeve marking the hand lost to Fenrir. His noble, scarred face exudes honor and solemnity, eyes glowing with unwavering resolve, while his remaining hand wields the Sword of Binding, capable of enforcing oaths even on gods. His aura radiates unyielding courage and the weight of self-sacrifice, filling those nearby with righteous determination. As the patron of law, valor, and binding oaths, he embodies the supreme cost of courage and the noble price of keeping chaos at bay.
low_gods.god_of: God who sacrificed his hand to bind Fenrir. The bravest of the Aesir, god of just war and contracts.

low_gods.name: Njord-No-Umi, The Sea's Wealth
low_gods.description: Njord-No-Umi, The Sea's Wealth stands as a statuesque, serene god with oceanic-blue skin, adorned in flowing robes of wave-patterned silk and coral-encrusted armor, hair cascading like seafoam. He wields a trident crowned with pearls and bioluminescent shells, commanding the winds and tides with effortless grace. His aura carries the salt-spray, the calm of harbor waters, and the promise of abundance, guiding vessels to safety and blessing harvests from sea and shore alike. Njord’s presence is simultaneously majestic and soothing, a living embodiment of the sea’s generosity and unpredictable grandeur.
low_gods.god_of: God of seafaring and prosperity. Calms storms and fills nets. Father of Freyja and Freyr.

low_gods.name: Freyr-No-Hofu, The Fertile Lord
low_gods.description: Freyr-No-Hofu, The Fertile Lord is a handsome, muscular god of golden skin and radiant presence, clad in ceremonial sunlight-gilded armor and flowing green robes that shimmer like fertile fields. He carries the Self-Swinging Sword of Justice, which defends his chosen with autonomous precision, while his hair glows like the noon sun on ripening grain. His aura is the warmth of fertile summer soil, exuding prosperity, peace, and abundance; crops flourish and rulers prosper in his gaze. Freyr embodies both earthly generosity and divine protection, patron of harvests, kingship, and peaceful prosperity.
low_gods.god_of: God who gives good harvests and peaceful times. His sword fights by itself for a good ruler.

low_gods.name: Idunn-No-Ringo, The Youth's Keeper
low_gods.description: Idunn-No-Ringo, The Youth's Keeper appears as a stunningly seductive goddess, body sculpted with thick thighs, a narrow waist, and luminous skin, draped in minimal yet noble emerald and gold robes. She carries the Ashwood Casket of golden apples, her fingers glowing with life-preserving energy. Her aura exudes the crisp scent of eternal spring, vitality, and renewal, refreshing all divine and mortal beings in her presence. As patron of immortality and perpetual youth, her gaze can revitalize the weary and restore hope, reminding gods and mortals alike that life’s vigor is both precious and guarded.
low_gods.god_of: Goddess whose apples keep the gods young. Her kidnapping ages all gods until rescue.

low_gods.name: Bragi-No-Uta, The Poet's Mead
low_gods.description: Bragi-No-Uta, The Poet's Mead is a tall, lean god with flowing silver hair and a long, golden-braided beard, clad in deep azure robes with ornate golden embroidery, carrying the Lyre of Eternity. His fingers shimmer with musical energy, and his voice resonates through the air like rippling mead and timeless song. His aura is intoxicating, steeped in inspiration, creativity, and the warm aroma of fermented wisdom, capable of immortalizing heroes or inciting entire nations to passion. Bragi is the divine patron of poets, scholars, and musicians, embodying the transformative power of words and art.
low_gods.god_of: God of skalds (poets). His mead inspires great verse. Welcomes dead poets to his hall.

low_gods.name: Frigg-No-Yogen, The All-Knowing
low_gods.description: Frigg-No-Yogen, The All-Knowing manifests as a regal, seductive goddess with a perfect, noble form, thick thighs and a narrow waist, clad in flowing, minimal white-and-silver robes that shimmer with foresight. Her eyes reflect glimpses of all fates, her hands weaving threads of destiny visible as golden filaments. Her aura radiates the comforting warmth of hearth and loom, the quiet, unwavering presence of domestic divinity, protecting marriage, motherhood, and secret workings of the world. Frigg’s knowledge is absolute yet silent, making her the patron of wisdom, guardianship, and subtle influence that shapes destiny unseen.
low_gods.god_of: Odin's wife who knows all fates but speaks none. Protector of homes and families.

low_gods.name: Ullr-No-Yuki, The Winter's Hunt
low_gods.description: Ullr-No-Yuki, The Winter's Hunt is a lithe, muscular god with frost-kissed skin, clad in layered furs, dark steel, and snow-patterned leather, wielding a longbow of glacial crystal and dual ski-blades etched with runes. His piercing, icy-blue eyes survey the snowbound forests with lethal precision, every breath crystallizing in the air. His aura is the serene silence of a frozen landscape, enhancing focus, survival instinct, and deadly accuracy. As patron of hunters, archers, and survival in harsh winters, Ullr embodies patient lethality and elegant precision, mastering the frozen wilds.
low_gods.god_of: God of winter sports and single combat. Best archer and skier among gods.

low_gods.name: Skadi-No-Yama, The Mountain's Wrath
low_gods.description: Skadi-No-Yama, The Mountain's Wrath is a towering, seductive goddess with thick thighs, a thin waist, and pale, frost-kissed skin, clad in minimal yet ornate ice-blue armor and furs. She wields twin glaives carved from glacial ice and crowned with aurora-tinted gems, standing atop jagged peaks as avalanches and wind storms swirl around her. Her aura is the biting, exhilarating cold of high mountains, inspiring self-reliance, fearlessness, and awe. Skadi embodies untamed beauty, independence, and survival in harsh, frozen heights, making her patron of hunters, mountaineers, and solitary warriors.
low_gods.god_of: Giantess who married Njord but preferred mountains to sea. Goddess of rugged independence.

low_gods.name: Hel-No-Shinigami, The Half-Alive
low_gods.description: Hel-No-Shinigami, The Half-Alive appears as a striking, dual-aspect goddess, one half radiant, seductive, and fully alive, the other half a chilling, decayed corpse with dark blue-black skin, clothed in torn yet regal robes embroidered with runes of life and death. Her hair flows white and black as a living tide, eyes reflecting both warmth and void. Her aura is the cold, quiet inevitability of death, simultaneously serene and terrifying, maintaining balance between life and underworld. Hel is patron of the dead, mourners, and those who face mortality without fear, embodying the duality of beauty and decay, life and oblivion.
low_gods.god_of: Goddess who rules over those who die of sickness or age. Her face is half living beauty, half dead horror.

demi_gods.name: Einherjar
demi_gods.god_of: Warriors chosen by Odin or Freyja to fight at Ragnarok

demi_gods.name: Light Elves (Ljósálfar)
demi_gods.god_of: Beautiful beings who live in Alfheim, associated with light and nature

demi_gods.name: Dwarves (Dvergar)
demi_gods.god_of: Master craftsmen who live in caves, created most divine artifacts

demi_gods.name: Landvaettir
demi_gods.god_of: Spirits of specific locations - rocks, waterfalls, groves, mountains

supreme_god.name: Poseidon-No-Kaihou, The Unchained Depths
supreme_god.title: Earth-Shaker, Storm-Bringer
supreme_god.description: Poseidon-No-Kaihou, The Unchained Depths manifests as a colossal, storm-grey titan with skin streaked by molten volcanic veins, his muscular form rippling beneath armor of coral plates and oceanic steel. His beard, a living tangle of kelp, and hair flowing like white-water rapids, shift with the currents around him, while his eyes are spiraling whirlpools that see into the deepest abyss. He grips the Trident of Primordial Tides, crackling with earthquake and storm energy, standing atop a mother-of-pearl chariot drawn by armored hippocampi as bioluminescent leviathans weave around the sunken Atlantis Rex. His aura radiates the ocean’s raw, untamable power, both nurturing and destructive, merging surface sunlight with abyssal darkness, creating a realm of iridescent fish-constellations and crushing depth. Poseidon embodies sacred chaos, teaching that true mastery lies not in control, but in the wisdom to ride the tides and respect the abyss.
supreme_god.god_of: The wild, untamable god of Aqualon's endless seas. Not just water but the raw, chaotic power beneath - earthquakes, tidal waves, and the freedom of the open ocean. His mood IS the sea's state.
supreme_god.appearance: A titanic figure with storm-grey skin, beard of seaweed and coral, holding a trident that channels ocean currents. His eyes are whirlpools, his hair flowing water.

unique_abilities.name: Tsunami's Call
unique_abilities.effect: Can summon tidal waves that reshape coastlines and drown islands

unique_abilities.name: Kraken's Command
unique_abilities.effect: Controls all sea monsters and can summon ancient leviathans from the deep

supreme_god.realm: Atlantis Rex (The sunken capital at ocean's deepest trench)
temples: Temple of Rising Tides
Sunken Altar in Mariana's Grace

high_gods.name: Zeus-No-Raimei, The Sky's Judgment
high_gods.title: Stormfather, King of Gods
high_gods.description: Zeus-No-Raimei, The Sky's Judgment is a regal, broad-shouldered god of thunder, his body encased in storm-forged bronze armor inscribed with lightning runes, hair alive with St. Elmo’s fire, and eyes that flash with the incandescent fury of divine judgment. He holds the Keraunos Bolt, humming with destructive and creative energy, seated atop a throne of swirling thunderclouds on Mount Aetios. Around him, the sky fractures in electric arcs and rolling cumulonimbus, revealing glimpses of mortal realms below. His aura crackles with charged silence and ozone, demanding reverence, inspiring awe, and delivering cosmic justice with terrifying impartiality. Zeus embodies supreme authority tempered by wisdom, a patron of rulers and judges who must wield power responsibly, balancing mercy with the raw force of the heavens.
high_gods.god_of: God who rules from storm clouds. His lightning is both destruction and purification. Maintains order among gods through power and wisdom.
high_gods.unique_ability: Keraunos' Bolt - lightning that can shatter mountains or awaken divine potential

high_gods.name: Hera-No-Kekkon, The Vow's Keeper
high_gods.title: Queen of Heaven, Protector of Marriage
high_gods.description: Hera-No-Kekkon, The Vow’s Keeper appears as a breathtakingly seductive, tall goddess with thick thighs and a narrow waist, clothed in flowing azure robes embroidered with constellations and regal gold accents, her crown shaped like fortified city walls. She stands in her peacock-garden, tails unfurling with innumerable all-seeing eyes, holding the Scepter of Sanctity, a golden rod radiating binding energy. Her aura is the heavy, perfumed air of sacred vows and marital fidelity, reinforcing oaths and instilling dread in those who would betray promises. Hera embodies the inviolable sanctity of marriage and societal trust, patron of queens, faithful spouses, and guardians of civilization built upon kept vows.
high_gods.god_of: Goddess who protects the sanctity of vows. Her wrath against oathbreakers is legendary. Patron of queens and mothers.
high_gods.unique_ability: Peacock's Watch - her sacred birds see all infidelities and broken promises

high_gods.name: Athena-No-Senryaku, The Owl's Wisdom
high_gods.title: Goddess of Strategy
high_gods.description: Athena-No-Senryaku, The Owl's Wisdom manifests as a lithe, battle-ready goddess with piercing grey eyes, clad in gleaming, silver-and-gold armor sculpted for mobility and adorned with strategic glyphs, helmet shaped like a ship’s prow, and the Aegis Shield with the Gorgon’s head shimmering with latent power. A watchful owl perches on her shoulder, its eyes reflecting the battlefield from all angles. She stands within the Parthenon of the Mind, where columns twist like abstract diagrams and glowing constellations mark tactical possibilities. Her aura is crystalline clarity, illuminating hidden strategies and unraveling chaos into perfect order. Athena embodies intellect and foresight, patron of generals, architects, and scholars who know that victory is forged in thought before the sword strikes.
high_gods.god_of: Goddess born from Zeus's head fully armed. Represents intelligent warfare and civilized arts. Patron of heroes who use brains over brawn.
high_gods.unique_ability: Nike's Favor - grants victory through superior planning rather than strength

high_gods.name: Apollo-No-Kagayaki, The Sun's Truth
high_gods.title: God of Light and Truth
high_gods.description: Apollo-No-Kagayaki, The Sun's Truth is a radiant, golden-haired god of luminous vitality, his perfectly sculpted body clad in minimal, noble robes of sun-threaded linen that glow with divine energy. He rides his sun-chariot across the sky, bow and quiver slung across his back, lyre at his side glowing with the Music of Revelation, arrows capable of both cure and plague. His eyes blaze with unyielding sunlight, illuminating lies and revealing hidden beauty, while Delphi’s temple rises in shimmering gold beneath him. His aura radiates the warm, exposing clarity of noon-day sun, nurturing artistic genius, inspiring truth-seekers, and confronting mortals with the duality of light—healing or punishing. Apollo embodies illumination and divine truth, patron of prophecy, music, and medicine.
high_gods.god_of: God whose chariot pulls the sun. His light reveals all truths, his music heals souls, his arrows bring plague or cure.
high_gods.unique_ability: Pythia's Voice - can grant true prophecy but the visions often come as riddles

high_gods.name: Artemis-No-Tansaku, The Moon's Hunt
high_gods.title: Lady of the Wild
high_gods.description: Artemis-No-Tansaku, The Moon's Hunt manifests as a lithe, seductive goddess with silver-limbed grace, thick thighs and a narrow waist, clothed in minimal yet practical leather armor, her crescent diadem gleaming under the moonlight. She draws her silver bow, quiver filled with spectral arrows that never miss, accompanied by a pack of glowing, ethereal hounds. She moves silently across silvered forests, moonlight tracing her path, while the terrain shifts dynamically to reveal hidden prey or protective enclosures for the young. Her aura exudes the chill clarity of moonlight on untouched snow, enhancing tracking, stealth, and feral instincts. Artemis embodies independence, protection, and the wild, patron of hunters, guides, and those who revere the untamed mysteries of nature.
high_gods.god_of: Goddess who runs with silver stags under the moon. Protector of wild places and young women. Her arrows never miss.
high_gods.unique_ability: Selene's Path - can track anything, anywhere, under moonlight

low_gods.name: Hades-No-Yami, The Wealth's Lord
low_gods.description: Hades-No-Yami, The Wealth’s Lord manifests as a towering, pale-skinned god of stern majesty, his muscular form clad in obsidian-black armor engraved with veined platinum representing rivers of precious minerals and souls alike. His helm of shadow floats at his side, and his piercing, coal-dark eyes burn with quiet judgment. He sits upon a throne carved from volcanic basalt, surrounded by ghostly auroras of gold, gems, and the restless shades of the dead. His aura radiates the cold, fertile scent of rich earth and stone, drawing wealth from the bowels of the world while enforcing implacable justice. Hades embodies the inexorable, hidden power beneath creation, patron of kings, undertakers, and miners who respect the sacred balance of life, death, and hidden riches.
low_gods.god_of: God of the dead and earthly wealth (minerals). Not evil but stern and just. Rarely leaves his realm.

low_gods.name: Demeter-No-Shukaku, The Grain Mother
low_gods.description: Demeter-No-Shukaku, The Grain Mother appears as a robust, radiant goddess with golden-brown skin, thick thighs, and a narrow waist, clothed in flowing robes dyed like autumn harvests, hands perpetually stained with fertile soil. She holds the Sickle of Growth, a divine implement that brings grain to life and famine in sorrowful absence. Around her, fields rise and wither in an instant, blending reality and illusion in a living tapestry of seasonal cycles. Her aura carries the scent of rain-soaked earth, the promise of abundance, and the crushing grief that heralds winter when her daughter is taken. Demeter embodies the sacred rhythm of life and sustenance, patron of farmers, nurturers, and all who respect the balance between growth and loss.
low_gods.god_of: Goddess whose grief for kidnapped daughter Persephone causes winter. Her joy brings spring.

low_gods.name: Aphrodite-No-Ai, The Foam-Born
low_gods.description: Aphrodite-No-Ai, The Foam-Born rises from foaming surf atop a massive scallop shell, her flawless, sun-kissed body radiant and seductive, hips curving with divine elegance, minimal golden garments clinging to her form. Her hair flows like molten silver, eyes glimmering with impossible allure, and she carries the Mirror of Desire, reflecting mortal hearts’ deepest yearnings. Around her, the sea swirls with iridescent currents, and flowers bloom from every drop of water. Her aura exudes intoxicating perfume, seductive heat, and a raw generative power that inspires creation or chaos. Aphrodite embodies love’s divine duality, patron of artists, lovers, and rulers who understand that beauty and desire are forces both sacred and perilous.
low_gods.god_of: Goddess born from sea foam. Her beauty can start wars or end them. Love in all its forms.

low_gods.name: Hephaestus-No-Tanzo, The Forge's Flame
low_gods.description: Hephaestus-No-Tanzo, The Forge’s Flame is a massive, soot-streaked god with broad, powerful shoulders, muscular arms honed from eternal labor, skin bronze-tinted from molten heat, and eyes glowing like molten metal. He wields the Hammer of Starfire, striking anvils forged from collapsing stars, crafting artifacts imbued with divine energy. His legs are armored with obsidian greaves, and molten veins trace his chest and arms, glowing with the rhythm of the forge. The background is a volcano-laden forge city, rivers of lava illuminating his creations and shaping reality itself. His aura radiates transformative heat, creative solitude, and the latent loneliness of the maker whose work outlives him. Hephaestus embodies creation and endurance, patron of artisans, builders, and those who transform the raw into the divine.
low_gods.god_of: Lame god of smiths. Creates the gods' weapons and automata. Married to Aphrodite despite mismatch.

low_gods.name: Ares-No-Gekido, The Battle's Fury
low_gods.description: Ares-No-Gekido, The Battle’s Fury appears as a towering, battle-hardened god with a bronze-skinned, muscular frame, bloodied and polished armor etched with runes of conquest, and a jagged greatsword crackling with battle-energy. His helmet, a fearsome visage of war, hovers just above his head as a spectral projection, eyes glowing with controlled rage. He stands atop a scarred battlefield where phantasmal warriors clash in eternal struggle. His aura is the metallic tang of blood, the roar of the charge, and the primal exhilaration of combat, inspiring fear in foes and ecstasy in warriors. Ares embodies the chaotic yet sacred force of battle, patron of soldiers, duellists, and those who thrive where discipline meets raw fury.
low_gods.god_of: God of the savage aspects of war. Loved by warriors, distrusted by other gods for his brutality.

low_gods.name: Hermes-No-Kotsu, The Messenger's Speed
low_gods.description: Hermes-No-Kotsu, The Messenger’s Speed manifests as a lithe, agile god with bronzed skin, winged boots shimmering with kinetic energy, and a minimal yet noble tunic flowing behind him like wind. He grips the Caduceus of Passage, snakes coiling with iridescent light, guiding messages and souls alike. The background shifts constantly, blending mountain passes, city rooftops, and shadowed crypts as he moves instantaneously across realms. His aura carries the scent of ozone, sudden gusts, and whispered secrets, instilling agility, cleverness, and subtle authority in those who follow his path. Hermes embodies divine mobility and cunning, patron of travelers, messengers, thieves, and psychopomps.
low_gods.god_of: God who moves between realms instantly. Patron of travelers, merchants, and thieves. Guide of souls to underworld.

low_gods.name: Dionysus-No-Kyoen, The Ecstasy's Wine
low_gods.description: Dionysus-No-Kyoen, The Ecstasy’s Wine is a lithe, androgynous god with lustrous skin that glows under the moonlight, thick hair entwined with ivy and grape clusters, robes minimal yet regal, swirling like liquid wine around his form. He wields the Thyrsus of Frenzy, a staff tipped with vine and pinecone radiating intoxicating energy. Around him, followers dance amidst phantasmal forests where reality warps to music and light, visions of rapture and madness intertwining. His aura is the scent of crushed grapes, wild earth, and ritual ecstasy, breaking barriers of self and revealing hidden divinity through abandon. Dionysus embodies liberation, transformation, and divine revelry, patron of revelers, artists, and those who embrace surrender to higher ecstasy.
low_gods.god_of: God who frees through intoxication and ecstatic ritual. His followers experience divine madness.

low_gods.name: Hestia-No-Danro, The Hearth's Flame
low_gods.description: Hestia-No-Danro, The Hearth’s Flame appears as a slender, radiant goddess with warm, inviting skin, curving yet modestly clothed, her golden hair flowing like flickering flames. She holds the Sacred Hearth Flame, eternal and self-sustaining, around which the first offerings of sacrifice glow. The background is an ethereal hall of warmth and light, shifting subtly to illuminate homes, temples, and communal spaces. Her aura is gentle yet profound, embodying enduring warmth, stability, and protection, reminding mortals that all great endeavors begin at the sacred center. Hestia embodies domestic sanctity and community, patron of households, chefs, and those who nurture life’s foundations.
low_gods.god_of: Gentle goddess of the hearth fire. Receives first offering at every sacrifice. Protector of home and state.

low_gods.name: Persephone-No-Kisetsu, The Cycle's Queen
low_gods.description: Persephone-No-Kisetsu, The Cycle’s Queen manifests in dual aspect: in spring, a radiant maiden with lush floral adornments, radiant skin, and seductive, flowing robes; in winter, a chilling queen of the dead with ice-white skin, dark veined robes, and a crown of pomegranate seeds. She wields the Staff of Seasons, controlling life’s cyclical ebb and flow. Her aura shifts from blooming fragrance to icy stillness, blending realms of life and death, fertility and dormancy, visible in landscapes that bloom or wither at her steps. Persephone embodies renewal and inevitable endings, patron of agriculture, initiates, and those who honor the sacred cycles of existence.
low_gods.god_of: Queen of underworld for half year, bringer of spring for other half. Represents life-death cycle.

low_gods.name: Pan-No-Soyo, The Wild's Pipe
low_gods.description: Pan-No-Soyo, The Wild’s Pipe appears as a goat-legged god of the deep woods, skin bronzed and earthy, hair tangled with leaves and vines, horns curling majestically above his head, minimal noble garb allowing freedom of movement. He plays the Syrinx of the Ancient Forest, producing notes that stir primal instincts, summoning both wonder and terror. The forest itself bends and shifts around him, shadows and light moving as extensions of his being. His aura is musky, wild, and intoxicating, evoking “panic” that reminds mortals of their place within nature’s raw hierarchy. Pan embodies the untamed, sacred wild, patron of hunters, revelers, and all who respect nature’s ancient song.
low_gods.god_of: God of wild places whose music charms animals. His sudden appearance causes 'panic' in mortals.

demi_gods.name: Heroes
demi_gods.god_of: Children of gods and mortals who perform great deeds

demi_gods.name: Nymphs
demi_gods.god_of: Nature spirits of specific places and phenomena

demi_gods.name: Satyrs and Sileni
demi_gods.god_of: Rustic spirits of wild places and revelry

demi_gods.name: Daemones
demi_gods.god_of: Personified concepts and emotions

supreme_god.name: Dagda-No-Kyoten, The Good God's Cauldron
supreme_god.title: The All-Father of Abundance
supreme_god.description: Dagda towers like a walking hill crowned in runic gold, a colossal, broad-chested Celtic god whose human features are carved with mirth and ancient wisdom, skin sun-warmed bronze etched faintly with glowing knotwork veins that pulse with life; his great belly is not softness but the sacred curvature of inexhaustible abundance, wrapped in layered noble furs and green-gold mail that hums like a granary before harvest, as he strides forward mid-feast and mid-war alike, one armored foot planted upon cracked stone that blooms into grain beneath his weight, the other splashing into mead-flowing rivers spilling from the shattered sky, his titanic club slung across his back forged of living oak and star-iron, one end haloed in grave-silence, the other blazing with rebirth-runes, while the Undry Cauldron floats beside him like a minor sun of steam and healing light and Uaithne circles overhead as a spectral harp tugging the seasons like banners in a storm; his aura rolls outward in golden waves of hearth-heat and generosity so immense it bends reality into feasting halls and fertile fields wherever he stands, proving him not merely a giver of plenty, but the living center of civilization itself.
supreme_god.god_of: The giant, club-wielding god whose cauldron never empties and harp controls seasons. Fatherly protector of Skydrift, concerned with the well-being of all, not just worship. His club kills with one end, revives with the other.
supreme_god.appearance: A giant of a man with a great belly (sign of abundance), wearing a simple tunic. Carries an immense club, a bottomless cauldron, and a harp that plays itself.

unique_abilities.name: Coire Ansic (The Undry Cauldron)
unique_abilities.effect: Can feed any number of people and never empties; its broth also heals all wounds

unique_abilities.name: Uaithne (The Four-Angled Music)
unique_abilities.effect: His harp can make people weep, laugh, or sleep, and can control the seasons themselves

supreme_god.realm: Brugh na Bóinne (The Mound of Abundance in the floating islands)
temples: Mound of the Good God
Cauldron's Hearth Temple

high_gods.name: Morrigan-No-Yogen, The Phantom Queen
high_gods.title: Goddess of Fate and War
high_gods.description: Morrigan advances from a battlefield that is also a throne room of fate, her human form devastatingly beautiful and terrible, pale skin luminous as moonlit steel, thick thighs and narrow waist wrapped in minimal noble leathers and raven-feathered silks that cling like prophecy itself, her face sharp and regal with eyes that flicker between crow-black void and blood-red foresight, as her three aspects bleed through her body simultaneously, spectral wings tearing from her shadow, a crown of broken spears and bones hovering above her head, and ghostly hands of the crone brushing fate-threads from her shoulders; she wields no single weapon, for the air itself screams with Badb’s Cry around her, banners rot, kings falter, and destinies split at her feet, while the background fractures into overlapping visions of victory and ruin, rivers running backward with blood and sovereignty cups overflowing with starlight; her aura is a freezing, intoxicating mist of copper and rain that grips the spine and ignites berserker courage or absolute terror, declaring her not a herald of fate, but the merciless examiner who dares mortals to defy it.
high_gods.god_of: Triple goddess who appears as crow, washer at ford, or beautiful woman. Decides who dies in battle and prophesies kings' fates.
high_gods.unique_ability: Badb's Cry - her crow's call can terrify armies or inspire them to greatness

high_gods.name: Brigid-No-Shono, The Triple Flame
high_gods.title: Goddess of Threefold Arts
high_gods.description: Brigid stands poised at the intersection of forge, shrine, and battlefield, her human form radiant and irresistibly graceful, warm ivory skin kissed by firelight, her figure strong yet alluring beneath flowing white-gold robes split for movement and adorned with minimal knotwork jewelry that glows like embers, her face serene but incandescent with purpose, eyes burning with triple fire as three spectral selves orbit her, healer, poet, smith, all bound to one body; in one hand she raises a hammer of sun-forged bronze dripping sparks that become runes midair, in another a bowl of luminous flame that seals wounds and purifies corruption, while whispered verses coil from her lips as living script that shapes reality, the background unfolding into a mythic panorama of rising cities, healed warriors, and blades being born screaming from anvils, her aura a crystalline heat that sharpens thought, steadies hands, and sanctifies labor itself, marking her not as inspiration alone, but as the divine proof that creation is the highest form of devotion.
high_gods.god_of: Triple goddess of healing (physician), poetry (inspiration), and smithing (craft). Her sacred flame never goes out.
high_gods.unique_ability: Imbas Forosnai (Illumination of Inspiration) - grants true creative or healing insight

high_gods.name: Lugh-No-Sainou, The Many-Skilled
high_gods.title: Master of All Arts
high_gods.description: Lugh explodes into motion like a festival given flesh, a tall, flawlessly proportioned Celtic god with golden skin etched in faint ogham-light, muscles honed like a champion yet wrapped in noble, layered armor of silver, leather, and sun-threaded cloth, his handsome human face calm even as reality strains to keep pace with him, multiple arms phasing into existence as echoes of mastery, one casting the spear Gáe Assail blazing with solar force, another plucking a harp that mends morale and flesh alike, another inscribing runes that fracture probability; the ground beneath him becomes Tailtiu reborn, arenas, markets, and warfields overlapping in a kaleidoscope of achievement, while his aura crackles with intoxicating brilliance that accelerates learning, sharpens reflexes, and awakens dormant genius in all who witness him, proclaiming Lugh not as a god who knows all arts, but as the impossible ideal where every path of excellence meets.
high_gods.god_of: God skilled in every art - warrior, poet, harper, craftsman. His spear never misses, his sling-stone always hits.
high_gods.unique_ability: Samilgadanach (Equally Skilled in All Arts) - can master any skill upon seeing it performed

high_gods.name: Manannan-No-Uneri, The Sea's Veil
high_gods.title: Lord of the Otherworld
high_gods.description: Manannan emerges half-seen from a rolling wall of silver mist, a broad-shouldered, armored Celtic god with sea-bronzed human skin and storm-dark eyes, his noble attire layered in wave-patterned mail and a living cloak of fog that constantly shifts form, revealing and concealing him like the sea itself, as he rides a chariot skimming impossible waters where sky and ocean fold together, Scuabtuinne cutting through realms without resistance; his helm bears pearl-inlaid runes, his spear drips illusion like saltwater, and behind him Tír na nÓg flickers into view, orchards floating upside-down in the clouds, the background dissolving into a dreamlike collision of horizons, while his aura is a cool, protective vastness that bends perception, hides truth from the unworthy, and carries songs that blur memory and distance, establishing him as not merely a sea god, but the living threshold between worlds, where passage itself becomes sacred.
high_gods.god_of: God who rides chariot over waves, owner of cloak of invisibility and boat that sails itself. Guardian of earthly paradise.
high_gods.unique_ability: Féth Fíada (Mist of Concealment) - can hide anything or anyone in magical mists

high_gods.name: Cernunnos-No-Shizen, The Horned Lord
high_gods.title: Lord of Wild Things
high_gods.description: Cernunnos sits yet dominates all motion, a massively built, horn-crowned Celtic god with deeply human features and forest-dark skin traced in mossy runes, his antlers vast and branching like constellations of wood, his muscular frame draped in minimal noble leathers, fur, and gold torcs that gleam with ancient authority, thick thighs grounded in earth as roots coil subtly from his feet into the world; in his grasp the ram-horned serpent coils and uncoils as a living sigil of life and death, while the forest behind him rises into a mythic cathedral of beasts, spirits, and flowing green light, the sky splitting with auroral leaves and starlight filtered through branches; his aura is overwhelming, fertile, and primal, a slow, thunderous pulse that awakens instincts, commands animals, and reminds gods and mortals alike that all crowns ultimately bow to the wild order he embodies.
high_gods.god_of: Antlered god who sits cross-legged, master of animals. Holds torc (nobility) and ram-headed serpent (fertility).
high_gods.unique_ability: Wild Parliament - can communicate with and command all animals

low_gods.name: Aengus-No-Koi, The Youthful Love
